pages.title: Woom OFF AIR 6 - Donnybrook Bikes
pages.description: Bike 26″ • 11kg Child 10 – 14 years • 140 – 165 cm – Disc brake, Suspension fork     The woom OFF AIR 6 offers children aged ten years and older a superlight and durable mountain bike with front suspension ideal for mastering even the trickiest of trails. This is all down to the suspension fork along with the special narrow-wide chainring, ultra-smooth shifting and grippy, wide tyres. All that mountain-biking parents will see of their kids is a cloud of dust!
